scoring_rules.acceptable_primary: An arm's primary label is scored acceptable if it is in this list (Arm D: its first primary_types entry).
scoring_rules.required_modifiers: Each one not detected by an arm is a MISSED material modifier.
scoring_rules.contestable_modifiers: Neither rewarded nor penalized: reasonable readers may disagree.
scoring_rules.other_modifiers: A detected modifier outside required+contestable is an UNSUPPORTED assertion.
scoring_rules.material_conditions: Anchors are exact substrings of the clause text. compare.py reports a mechanical AUTO_HINT when an arm quotes text overlapping an anchor; whether the arm actually understood the condition requires HUMAN_ADJUDICATION.
scoring_rules.unresolved_dependencies: explicit_in_text=true: the excerpt or packet names the missing item. explicit_in_text=false: an implicit dependency that the context pack deliberately does NOT call out; these are the most discriminating omissions.
scoring_rules.holds: A HOLD is not counted as correct. Coverage (candidate vs hold) is reported separately from errors.
